anatomy.original: Verification by fresh isolated subagents, three lenses, a fixed vote table; engine-category findings get a lens that judges only whether the match is real; inline and labelled when secscan runs nested — why: an author grading its own finding confirms it.
anatomy.ste: Fresh, isolated subagents verify each finding through three lenses. A fixed vote table gives the verdict. For an engine finding, the verifier checks only that the match is real. When secscan runs inside a different skill, Claude verifies the finding and labels it. Reason: an author who grades its own finding confirms it.

anatomy.original: A known-bad engine is identified without running it (install path, Go build info) — why: a compromised binary must not run even once.
anatomy.ste: scan.py reads the version of an engine from its install path or from its Go build information. Thus, a compromised binary does not run one time.
